says: Today's tooling: decision 0123 decides that mutation.yaml gets a schedule trigger and that a mutation-heartbeat.yaml workflow runs beside it, but the tree holds neither.
proof: .github/workflows/mutation.yaml:4-8 says only a person or a scheduler session starts it and that no push, pull request or cron starts it, and its `on:` (line 12) holds only workflow_dispatch; .github/workflows/ has no mutation-heartbeat.yaml (the heartbeat is .agents/skills/mutation/scripts/heartbeat.ts); the only cron in .github/workflows/scheduled.yaml:93 is `17 * * * *` for the full run (0581), and scheduled.yaml has no mutation job.
cost: A reader who trusts 0123 or 0535 (mutation runs every 3 hours on the schedule) looks for a schedule that mutation.yaml does not have, and a stalled mutation run raises no alarm.
